defs.def: to fall or allow sth to fall by accident （意外地）落下，掉下，使落下

ex.s: From the Australian side, we have only a wooden shield (盾) dropped by a man in flight after his first experience of gunshot.
ex.t: 从澳大利亚一方那里，我们只有一面木盾（盾），是一个人在第一次经历枪击后逃跑时丢下的。

defs.def: to fall or make sth fall deliberately （故意）降下，使降落，使落下

ex.s: The thief drops to the ground.
ex.t: 他拿出一个特殊设备，对准嫌疑人，打开开关。

defs.def: to fall down or be no longer able to stand because you are extremely tired 累倒；累垮

ex.s: My parents, who are doctors, dropped everything and began trying to___18___what had happened.
ex.t: 我的父母是医生，他们放下一切，开始试图____18____发生了什么。

defs.def: to become or make sth weaker, lower or less （使）变弱，降低，减少

ex.s: According to the World Wildlife Fund, the global black rhino population has dropped as low as 5500, giving the rhinos a “critically endangered” status.
ex.t: 根据世界自然基金会，全球黑犀牛数量已降至低至5500头，使犀牛处于极危状态。

defs.def: to look down 垂下（眼睛）；垂视
to slope steeply downwards 急剧倾斜而下
to stop so that sb can get out of a car, etc; to deliver sth on the way to somewhere else 中途卸客；中途卸货
to send a short letter to sb 寄，送，写（信）

ex.s: He had been dropped off at school late and was ____4____ to open the door.
ex.t: 他很晚才被送到学校，正在____4____努力开门。

ex.s: After dropping the kids off at school, of course.
ex.t: 当然，是在把孩子送到学校之后。

ex.s: I really did not know whether I should continue correcting him or simply drop the matter.
ex.t: 写字似乎是绘画的另一种形式。

defs.def: to leave sb/sth out by accident or deliberately 遗漏；省略；不予考虑
to stop seeing sb socially 不再与（某人）往来；同（某人）断绝联系

ex.s: Galileo was not merely ambitious when he dropped objects of varying weights from the Leaning Tower at Pisa and timed their fall to the ground.
ex.t: 伽利略并非只是好高骛远，当他从比萨斜塔扔下重量不同的物体并计时它们落地时。

ex.s: The bookstore, which was a legendary fixture in the neighbourhood, was a place where anyone could drop in and connect through their love of books.
ex.t: 这家书店是社区里的一个传奇场所，任何人都可以顺便进来，通过他们对书籍的热爱联系在一起。

ex.s: The reason for the explosion is not that people have been reproducing like rabbits, but that people have stopped dropping dead like flies.
ex.t: 人口爆炸的原因不是人们像兔子一样繁殖，而是人们不再像苍蝇一样大量死亡。

ex.s: I could see the runners straining to run as fast as they could, while trying not to drop their batons at the change.
ex.t: 我能看到选手们拼命地尽可能快地跑，同时努力不在交接时掉落接力棒。

defs.def: to stop doing or discussing sth; to not continue with sth 停止；终止；放弃
to say or do sth in order to show sb, in an indirect way, what you are thinking 暗示；透露
to let a stitch go off the needle 漏，脱，掉（针）

ex.s: I nearly dropped the book.
ex.t: 我差点把书掉了。

ex.s: The card dropped off into a lake by accident.
ex.t: 卡不小心掉进了湖里。

ex.s: The train moved on．The little boy was ____5____ awake on his mother's lap，but the woman dropped off to sleep．A moment later，he began to____6____the half-open window—one leg went over it．The man jumped up and ____7____the child just before he fell out．
ex.t: 火车继续前行。小男孩___5___醒着躺在母亲腿上，但女人睡着了。片刻后，他开始___6___那半开的车窗——一条腿已经跨了过去。男子跳起来，在孩子掉出去前___7___了他。

ex.s: A lady sitting in her rocking and shaking home, saw the wall part from the ceiling, open and shut twice, like a mouth, and then drop the end of a brick on the floor like a tooth.
ex.t: 一位坐在摇摇晃晃的家里椅子上的女士，看到墙壁从天花板上裂开，像嘴巴一样开了又合两次，然后把一块砖头的一头像牙齿一样掉在地板上。

ex.s: For the “unable” scenario, the experimenter would again move the treat towards the hole while the dog watched, but “accidentally” drop it before they could pass it through.
ex.t: 在“无能为力”的情形中，实验者会再次当着狗的面把零食移向小孔，但在穿过小孔之前“不小心”把它掉在了地上。

ex.s: I actually wanted to drop the class at one point, but stopped short because I didn't want to give him the satisfaction of my chickening out.
ex.t: 我有一次其实想退掉这门课，但没退成，因为我不想让他因我的退缩而得逞。

defs.def: to die suddenly and unexpectedly 暴毙；突然死去；猝死
别烦人；别打扰；别捣乱
to do or say nothing more about sb/sth 不再提起；放弃
to mention sb/sth in a conversation, by accident or as if by accident （好像是）无意中说出
to fall into a light sleep 打盹儿；小睡
to become fewer or less 减少；下降

ex.s: In the study, boiling hard water containing 300 milligrams of calcium carbonate led to an almost 90 percent drop in plastics.
ex.t: 研究中，煮沸含有300毫克碳酸钙的硬水，使塑料含量下降了近90%。

ex.s: Children, on the other hand, have no idea that insect population has dropped dramatically.
ex.t: 另一方面，孩子们根本不知道昆虫数量已经大幅下降。

ex.s: The Chinese Ministry of Agriculture finds that between 2005 – when the government   68   (start) a soil – testing program   69   gives specific fertilizer recommendations to farmers – and 2011, fertilizer use dropped by 7.7 million tons.
ex.t: 中国农业部发现，在2005年（政府___68___ start一项为农民提供具体施肥建议的测土配方项目）至2011年间，化肥使用量下降了770万吨。

ex.s: But driverless car ownership could increase as the prices drop and more people become comfortable with the technology.
ex.t: 但随着价格下降，越来越多的人对技术感到适应，无人驾驶汽车保有量可能会增加。

defs.def: to no longer take part in or be part of sth 不再参加；退出；脱离

ex.s: Students often attend classes in which they are not enrolled on the first day of instruction to try adding this new course to the list, as other students may have dropped it.
ex.t: 学生常在开课第一天去上他们未注册的课程，试图把这门新课加入列表，因为其他学生可能已退课。

ex.s: After that, feeling the need to   52   further, I decided to drop in on one of ASL club’s meetings.
ex.t: 在那之后，感到有必要进一步____52____，我决定顺便去参加美国手语俱乐部的一次聚会。

defs.def: to leave school, college, etc. without finishing your studies 退学；辍学

ex.s: Dropping out of college.
ex.t: 退学了。

defs.def: to reject the ideas and ways of behaving that are accepted by the rest of society 拒绝传统社会
a very small amount of liquid that forms a round shape 滴；水珠

ex.s: When a solar still works, drops of water come into the cup form          .
ex.t: 当太阳能蒸馏器工作时，水滴会汇集到杯子里。

ex.s: It was said to be the worst in 60 years, and not a single drop of rain fell for almost a whole year.
ex.t: 据说这是60年来最严重的一次，几乎整整一年没有下一滴雨。

defs.def: a small quantity of a liquid 少量；微量；一点点
a fall or reduction in the amount, level or number of sth 下降；下跌；减少
a distance down from a high point to a lower point 下落的距离；落差
a liquid medicine that you put one drop at a time into your eyes, ears or nose 滴剂

ex.s: A bunch of us kids would frequently drop by the store after school.
ex.t: 我们一帮孩子放学后常顺道去那家店。

ex.s: Go through the procedures to drop it.
ex.t: 按照程序办理退课。

ex.s: If you choose to drop a course you must follow the UCLA procedures for removing it from your schedule.
ex.t: 如果你选择退一门课，你必须遵循UCLA将其从你的课表中移除的程序。

ex.s: If you forget to officially drop that course, a “F” (Fail) grade will be registered on your record at the end of the term.
ex.t: 如果你忘记正式退选那门课程，学期末你的成绩单上将记入一个“F”（不及格）成绩。

ex.s: You may change your class schedule during the first two weeks of the term by adding or dropping courses from your enrollment list.
ex.t: 你可以在学期前两周内通过增删选课列表中的课程来更改课表。

defs.def: the act of delivering sb/sth in a vehicle or by plane; the act of dropping sth 运送；空投

ex.s: Then I noticed folk conducting spring cleans dropping boxes of voluminous books on various subjects there.
ex.t: 后来我注意到人们在春季大扫除时往那里放了很多装满各种书籍的大箱子。

defs.def: a small round sweet/candy of the type mentioned 球状糖果
